niche.habitat: Surface crust near episodic vent sites; subsurface burrows
niche.diet: Rapid assimilation of vent chemicals (NH3, H2S, metal nitrides)
niche.active: Quiescent for decades; blooms for hours during seismic/thermal events

body: Crystalline silicate/nitride shell; spore-pod mechanism; vascularized radiators

links: Shell precipitates rapidly from vent fluids
Reducing chemistry favors nitrides over oxides
Physical root: Reducing atmosphere and vent chemistry

skill.effect: When drawn near warmth, the creature hardens its crystalline shell and deflects elemental attacks for a short while.

chains.weakness: Thermal shock cracks shell; sudden cooling causes explosive fragmentation.

journal.en: It sleeps as stone until the world breathes fire.

plausibility.summary: Reducing vent fluids (F6, F11) can favor nitride/carbide precipitation over oxides; rapid biomineralization coats for dormancy resist abrasion and chemical attack during long quiescence. Full ‘crystalline armor’ grown directly from vent fluid in hours is highly speculative but analogous to fast diatom silica deposition scaled to heat pulses.
fixes: Reducing vent fluids (F6, F11) can favor nitride/carbide precipitation over oxides; rapid biomineralization coats for dormancy resist abrasion and chemical attack during long quiescence. Full ‘crystalline armor’ grown directly from vent fluid in hours is highly speculative but analogous to fast diatom silica deposition scaled to heat pulses.

analogues.organism: Diatom silica frustules; vent tubeworm (Riftia) chitin tube with sulfide mineral incrustation
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded
see the cited works; chain wording is the council's own

links: Disperses via seismic vibration and pressure
Physical root: Episodic mantle plume tectonics

skill.effect: The creature erupts a cloud of shimmering spores that weakens the defenses of nearby foes for a time.

chains.weakness: Wind shear disperses spores; silence/pressure dampening prevents trigger.

journal.en: A flower that blooms only in death.

plausibility.summary: Emphasize spores as adhesive, dense-aerosol-settling propagules colonizing vent fractures within tens of meters, not wind-borne long-distance plumes.
fixes: Emphasize spores as adhesive, dense-aerosol-settling propagules colonizing vent fractures within tens of meters, not wind-borne long-distance plumes.

analogues.organism: Explosive seed dispersal in Hura crepitans (sandbox tree); puffball fungi pulsed spore clouds on impact
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Metabolism converts NH3 directly to biomass
Physical root: Reducing atmosphere and biochemistry

skill.effect: While feeding near warmth, the creature rapidly restores its vitality and strikes with renewed vigor.

chains.weakness: Oxygen exposure is toxic; aerobic weapons cause rapid decay.

journal.en: It drinks the poison and grows strong.

plausibility.summary: Direct NH₃ incorporation (F18) under reducing conditions avoids oxidative nitrogen fixation cost; bloom-phase growth on vent NH₃, H₂S, and metal-ion substrates is a credible chemosynthetic/heterotrophic surge metabolism.
fixes: Direct NH₃ incorporation (F18) under reducing conditions avoids oxidative nitrogen fixation cost; bloom-phase growth on vent NH₃, H₂S, and metal-ion substrates is a credible chemosynthetic/heterotrophic surge metabolism.

analogues.organism: Ammonia-oxidizing and urease-heavy microbes in anoxic nitrogen-rich systems; carnivorous plants’ rapid shoot growth on pulse nutrients
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

links: Blooms in response to ground vibration
Physical root: Stagnant-lid tectonics and plume activity

skill.effect: The creature triggers a ground tremor that temporarily immobilizes nearby foes while it recovers and grows stronger.

chains.weakness: Requires ground contact; floating/magnetic levitation negates trigger.

journal.en: The mountain wakes, and the glass remembers.

plausibility.summary: Require combined cue: seismic energy plus vent chemothermal pulse; quiescence ends when local heat and NH₃ flux drop, not merely when shaking stops.
fixes: Require combined cue: seismic energy plus vent chemothermal pulse; quiescence ends when local heat and NH₃ flux drop, not merely when shaking stops.

analogues.organism: Post-fire flowering in some Brassica relatives; fairy ring fungi fruiting after rainfall pulses—environmental trigger synchronization
analogues.mechanism: as named by the judge; no mechanism or reference recorded

relations.note: (council kind 'Resource Competition') Espinovent blooms clog vents; Eridians must blast them away to access metal-rich ores.

temperament: Aggressive blooming; returns to inert stone after energy depletion
secrets: Espinovent spores can be stabilized into powerful explosive charges.
Quiescent shells can be harvested as high-grade building material; living shells grant pressure immunity.
moments: The ground hums; the Espinovent shell fractures, releasing a cloud of sparkling nitride dust that coats everything in a deadly, beautiful shimmer before it crumbles back to stone.

journal.en: Patience is the weapon of the stone.
When the world shakes, the glass remembers how to bite.
